name: io.github.tonyyang0504/discord-messaging-mcp
description: Discord (messaging): me, send, reply, list_inbound, get_thread. Every tool maps to a documented endp

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bot token from the app's Bot page in the Developer Portal, pasted WITHOUT the 'Bot ' prefix: the runtime adds it and sends 'Authorization: Bot <token>' ('authentication is performed with the Authorization HTTP header in the format Authorization: TOKEN_TYPE TOKEN', https://docs.discord.com/developers/reference#authentication). Channel permissions needed: VIEW_CHANNEL + READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY (list_inbound, get_thread), SEND_MESSAGES (send, reply); the MESSAGE_CONTENT privileged intent to read other users' message content.
